## James Bond Box Office Analysis

This page examines the worldwide box office revenue of James Bond films over time.

```{python}
#| echo: true

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
bond = bond.sort_values("year")
```

## Bond Films Over Time

The first Bond film in this dataset was released in `{python} int(bond["year"].min())`, and the last was released in `{python} int(bond["year"].max())`.

The chart below shows how worldwide box office revenue changed across the Bond films in this dataset.

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| label: fig-bond-revenue
#| fig-cap: "Worldwide Box Office Revenue of James Bond Films"

plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"], marker="o")
plt.xlabel("Release Year")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide Revenue (Million USD)")
plt.title("James Bond Films: Revenue Over Time")
plt.show()
```
